theorem jordan_decomposition 
  {f : ℝ → ℝ} {s : Set ℝ}
  (hbv : ∀ x ∈ s, ∃ δ > 0, ∃ C : ℝ, C > 0 ∧
    ∀ a b : ℝ, a < b → Set.Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ) ⊇ Set.Icc a b →
    ∀ p : List ℝ, Sorted (· ≤ ·) p → 
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < p.length → p.get! i ∈ Set.Icc a b) →
    (Finset.range (p.length - 1)).sum (fun i => 
      abs (f (p.get! (i + 1)) - f (p.get! i))) ≤ C) :
  ∃ (g h : ℝ → ℝ), 
    Monotone g ∧ 
    Monotone h ∧
    (∀ x ∈ s, f x = g x - h x) := sorry
